description: Add AI-powered explanations: an 'Explain this' button on wrong answers that generates explanations via OpenAI or Anthropic, with streaming response and graceful fallback when no API key is configured
steps: Create src/features/ai-explanations/ directory structure: types/, utils/, components/, actions/

Add AI provider configuration: add AI_PROVIDER and AI_API_KEY (plus OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) to env handling. Create src/features/ai-explanations/utils/ai-provider.ts that selects between OpenAI and Anthropic based on AI_PROVIDER env var

Create src/features/ai-explanations/actions/explain-answer.ts server action that: validates input (question text, answer choices, selected answer, correct answer), calls the appropriate AI API with streaming, returns a ReadableStream or falls back gracefully if no API key

Create an API route at src/app/api/explain/route.ts that handles POST requests and returns streaming response using the AI provider. Use the Web Streams API for streaming. If no API key configured, return a JSON response with a fallback message

Create src/features/ai-explanations/components/explain-button.tsx - an 'Explain this' button that appears on wrong answers in the review flow. On click, calls the API route and shows a streaming explanation inline
Create src/features/ai-explanations/components/explanation-display.tsx - renders the streamed explanation with nice formatting, loading state, and error handling

Integrate the ExplainButton into the existing review flow: add it to src/features/question-bank/components/attempt-review.tsx where wrong answers are shown (within the answer review card when answer is incorrect)
Add a graceful fallback message component that shows when no AI_API_KEY is configured: 'AI explanations require an API key. Check the documentation for setup instructions.'
Add unit tests in src/features/ai-explanations/__tests__/explain.test.ts covering: provider selection logic, input validation, fallback behavior when no API key
Install no new dependencies - use native fetch for API calls to OpenAI/Anthropic REST APIs
Run full verification: npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test
acceptance_criteria: ExplainButton component renders on wrong answers in the review flow
Clicking the button triggers an API call to /api/explain
When AI_PROVIDER=openai and OPENAI_API_KEY is set, calls OpenAI API
When AI_PROVIDER=anthropic and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, calls Anthropic API
When no API key is configured, shows graceful fallback message
Explanation streams in and displays inline in the review flow
npm run lint passes with 0 errors/warnings
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
findings: Feature implemented with 7 new files: types, provider config, streaming utility, prompt builder, API route, ExplainButton, and ExplanationDisplay. Integrated into attempt-review.tsx for wrong answers only. 17 new tests pass (291 total). Build succeeds without API keys. The fallback path returns a JSON response with a friendly message when no API key is configured. Uses Fragment wrapper (<>) in attempt-review.tsx to group the ExplainButton and error classification within the incorrect-answer conditional.
